title: Crash when Selecting Quit to Project List if AnimationTree editor is on screen.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in 4.6


### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 (Apple9) - Apple M4 (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description


When I have a project open with the AnimationTree open and Quit to Project List, the entire application crashes.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new project
1. Create new 3d scene
1. Add Animation Player
1. Add AnimationTree
1. Set AnimationTree Tree Root to `AnimationNodeStateMachine`
1. Set Anim Player to the AnimationPlayer you just added to the scene.
2. Open the Anination Tree editor.
3. Save project.
4. Quit to Project List. 
5. Bang.
Alternatively, you can set the Rendering method to Mobile and click "Restart" and it also crashes.
